title: Always-on agents run production without the on-call tax — Justin Smith, Resolve AI
talk_summary: Resolve AI describes background agents that run on schedules, events, or messages in sandboxes, with shared memory and task systems, to handle production ops like deployment monitoring, health checks, reports, and Q&A. The practical mechanism is to give agents production context and let them create/update recurring tasks, with confidence-gated human confirmation.

takeaways.what_they_do: They trigger background agents on schedules, event streams like CI/CD or Slack, and direct messages, so work is pulled without a human creating every task.
takeaways.evidence_quote: event streams, so you know, there's lots of systems that will sort of push events

takeaways.what_they_do: The agent reads the actual release changes, infers which telemetry or causal chain matters, and builds a custom monitoring/check plan for that release instead of using only fixed CI checks.
takeaways.evidence_quote: look at the changes that are going in, understand what telemetry might help us evaluate

takeaways.what_they_do: They maintain a shared knowledge system that captures environment understanding and task reflections, then applies it across different agent tasks.
takeaways.evidence_quote: shared uh sort of knowledge system um works across all the different tasks

takeaways.technique: Agent edits its own recurring task instructions
takeaways.what_they_do: When a user says an output is too verbose or gives feedback, the agent updates the underlying task definition so the next scheduled run changes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: The agent is able to update its task underneath

takeaways.what_they_do: An agent watches channels, decides whether it is confident enough to answer, and DMs a human to confirm when unsure before responding publicly.
takeaways.evidence_quote: determine whether it has enough sort of confidence to answer the question or not

takeaways.what_they_do: Background agents run in cloud sandboxes with a filesystem, so they can self-organize work and keep running even when a laptop is closed.
takeaways.evidence_quote: runs inside of a sandbox, so it has kind of a file system underneath it
